description: Planner questions for retrieving carrier notices. One Chinese and one English question per event group: 12 disruption events from real_notices_v1 and 7 service groups from notice_facts_v1 (exploratory split).
author: One project author wrote these questions after reading the corpus and before running any retrieval. The Chinese-English glossary was written by the same author at the same time. This is a development check, not an independent evaluation.
relevance: A document is relevant when it belongs to the question's event group: event_group_id in benchmarks/real_notices_v1/dataset.json, group in benchmarks/notice_facts_v1/dataset.json.
independent_cases: 19 event groups. The Chinese and English questions of one group are two phrasings of the same case.
